## ⚠️ CRITICAL ALERTS

✅ **No critical values flagged.** All labs and vitals within normal limits. Routine post-op course.

## 📋 DAY PLAN

**Discharge blocker:** Tolerating PO and ambulating independently. She's close — likely going home today.

- [ ] Advance diet to regular breakfast
- [ ] Assess: tolerating solids without nausea?
- [ ] Assess: ambulating independently without assistance?
- [ ] Assess: pain controlled on PO meds alone?
- [ ] If yes to all → **discharge today**
- [ ] Discharge prescriptions: acetaminophen 1g q6h PRN, ibuprofen 400mg q6h PRN (with food), ondansetron 4mg PRN nausea
- [ ] Discharge instructions: regular diet, no heavy lifting >10lbs x4 weeks, shower OK (no submerging port sites), return precautions (fever >101, worsening pain, jaundice, nausea/vomiting unable to keep down fluids)
- [ ] Follow-up: surgery clinic 2 weeks
- [ ] Confirm ride home is arranged
- [ ] Continue home omeprazole
